banc.analysis:
No drug: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.016 over 3 runs (from 0.016 to 0.016).
Full dose: share of all neurons firing per step averaged 0.002 over 3 runs (from 0.002 to 0.002) — 86% less than no drug. 3 of 3 runs were on the predicted side of the no drug average; the gap (0.014) is 86.8× the run-to-run wobble (0.000).
Verdict for full dose: SUPPORTED — the direction held in almost every run and the gap is bigger than the wobble.
